title: National-level stone-grotto heritage and dense asset cluster
excerpt: The county describes Qianfoyan as a heritage-scenic area about 3 km west of the county seat. The grottoes were included in the sixth batch of Major Historical and Cultural Sites Protected at the National Level in 2006. The official introduction records 162 niches/caves and more than 2,470 stone sculptures, alongside the ancient plank-road remains, paper museum, temples, inscriptions and related heritage points.
notes: Use as evidence of resource concentration and heritage status. Different official pages report slightly different sculpture counts, so exact inventory figures should not be overinterpreted without a current conservation inventory.

title: 2025 May Day visitor volume was already substantial
source_name: Jiajiang County Culture, Radio, Television, Sports and Tourism Bureau via county government
excerpt: During the 2025 May Day holiday, Jiajiang reported more than 410,000 countywide visitors and tourism revenue of RMB 321 million. A-rated attractions received 190,100 visits; Dongfengyan-Qianfoyan accounted for 81,300 visits, up 9.61% year on year.
notes: Holiday traffic does not establish normal-period demand, trip purpose, dwell time, conversion, or repeat visitation. It does show that a simple 'nobody comes' diagnosis would be poorly supported for peak periods.

title: Operating finances rely heavily on admission while secondary consumption remains weak
source_name: Jiajiang County State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Bureau
excerpt: In an official response on free-admission proposals, the operator reported that admission contributed about 63% of total revenue. For the first half of 2025, scenic-area revenue was RMB 1.4117 million against expenditure of RMB 4.1302 million. Secondary-consumption items such as performances and specialty goods were described as still being cultivated and contributing less than 10% of revenue.
notes: This is unusually strong evidence for the current revenue structure. It does not reveal per-capita spend, product-level sales, visitor segmentation, or whether all operating expenditure should be recovered commercially.

title: Peak-period capacity is constrained by core heritage spaces
source_name: Jiajiang County State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Bureau
excerpt: The same official response states that core areas such as the Qianfoyan grottoes and Dongfengyan water-heritage spaces have limited physical capacity and that holiday traffic is already close to saturation, creating visitor-experience and conservation risks if load increases further.
notes: Peak saturation can coexist with low off-peak demand. This evidence should not be generalized into an annual capacity diagnosis without time-distributed traffic data.

title: Stone-grotto digitization and a digital exhibition hall have been developed
excerpt: A 2025 rectification update states that Qianfoyan completed digital data collection for the grottoes and had preliminarily established a digital grotto exhibition hall. A later county heritage article describes 3D scanning and digital reconstruction as tools for conservation, research and visitor interpretation.
notes: Evidence establishes that digital interpretation infrastructure exists or was being built. It does not establish visitor usage, learning outcomes, satisfaction, or whether digital content is integrated with the full on-site journey.

title: County self-assessment identified weak linkage with the wider grotto-heritage network
excerpt: In a formal rectification update, the county noted that Qianfoyan had entered the Sichuan-Chongqing Grotto Temple National Archaeological Site Park framework but that thinking on inter-site linkage remained insufficient and lacked concrete mechanisms. The follow-up actions included a cooperation agreement with the Dazu Rock Carvings Academy covering exhibitions, talent, academic exchange, publicity and visitor referral.
notes: This is valuable because it is an explicit institutional self-diagnosis rather than an external inference. It concerns network linkage and should not automatically be converted into a broader marketing conclusion.

title: The county is continuing to pursue research-tourism and product upgrades
excerpt: The 2026 government work report calls for strengthening the 'Fun Learning Jiajiang' research-tourism brand, developing more research routes and cultural products for multiple age groups, and continuing cultural-heritage documentation and digitization. Earlier 2025 policy documents also called for upgrading Dongfengyan-Qianfoyan and expanding heritage interpretation and research-tourism functions.
notes: This is evidence of intended policy direction, not evidence that the resulting products have been implemented successfully or adopted by visitors.

title: Significant hard-infrastructure upgrading preceded the current diagnostic period
excerpt: During the 4A-upgrade project, the county reported more than 30 construction items including an approximately 18-mu parking lot, five new or renovated toilets, Juxian Street facade improvements, scenic-point upgrades, walking-path improvements, a rear-mountain traffic loop and utility works. The attraction obtained national 4A status in January 2021.
notes: This establishes that basic visitor infrastructure has already received substantial investment. It does not prove current maintenance quality or eliminate localized infrastructure problems.

title: Current OTA footprint is positive but small and contains value-for-money concerns
excerpt: At retrieval, Ctrip displayed a 4.5/5 rating based on 51 reviews. Visible recent reviews included strong appreciation for the grottoes and irrigation heritage, but also a 2025 National Day review arguing that the RMB 50 ticket felt expensive and that the site was not compelling enough for an out-of-town dedicated trip. Another detailed review estimated about two hours for a fuller circuit but much less for only the stone-carving section.
notes: Small, self-selected platform sample. Useful as a qualitative signal, not as a representative visitor survey. Individual reviews must not be generalized without broader UGC sampling.

title: New surrounding-place concepts are being planned around the upgraded scenic area
source_name: Jiajiang County People's Government / Qingyi Subdistrict
excerpt: Qingyi Subdistrict described a future 'one core, five areas' place-making concept centered on the Dongfengyan-Qianfoyan upgrade, including a suburban park, forest park, rice-field park, artist residency, courtyard/food cluster and accommodation/food leisure businesses. The plan is linked to improved access from new expressway infrastructure.
notes: Evidence of planned diversification and spatial expansion, not current operating performance. Future projects should not be counted as existing products in diagnosis.
